The use of `'SKIP'` for the `.asc` file's checksum is normal and acceptable in this context, as signature files are validated using `validpgpkeys`, not hashes. All operations are consistent with standard AUR packaging practices.

Thus, sourcing this PKGBUILD and fetching its sources poses no risk of unintended or malicious execution.
</details>
